label: GPT-6 Luna

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Hi Grace, Derek Shaw with Brinewatch. Thanks for taking the call. So I'd love to just walk you through our platform real quick because I think it's a perfect fit for a bakery distributor.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Before you do, let me save us both some time. We're running a formal RFP for temperature monitoring in November. We'll invite three vendors and we'll pick one by December 15th.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Oh great, great, well, we'd love to be in that. Our platform covers trucks, warehouses, all of it and our customers love the app.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: We run 15 trucks of frozen dough and it has to stay at zero degrees or below. Last quarter we logged 41 excursions above that.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Well, okay, yeah, 41 is a lot, so.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: And each one means a product hold while quality checks it. The budget's already approved at $60,000 for the year.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Oh nice, well that's plenty for us, so the way it works is, sensors in every truck, alerts by text and a dashboard for the whole fleet. Setup is super fast.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Our COO, Raj Maita, makes the final decision and the RFP will ask for integration with our warehouse management system. Can you do that?

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Yeah totally, we integrate with pretty much everything.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Okay, to get on the invite list, I need your company information for vendor registration by the end of next week.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Sure thing I'll send that over, and hey, could we maybe do a demo before the RFP.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: No Demos outside the process. Everyone gets the same shot. Just send the registration information.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Got it I'll get that to you this week, thanks Grace.

reply: {"strengths":[{"text":"You welcomed the formal RFP and made it clear Brinewatch wants to participate.","segment":"s08-s003","quote":"we'd love to be in that."},{"text":"You gave a relevant, concrete overview of how the product could cover the fleet.","segment":"s08-s007","quote":"sensors in every truck, alerts by text and a dashboard for the whole fleet."},{"text":"You ended with a clear near-term commitment on the vendor paperwork.","segment":"s08-s013","quote":"I'll get that to you this week"}],"improvements":[{"text":"With zero questions on the call, you missed a chance to learn what 41 excursions and product holds cost them.","segment":"s08-s005","quote":"41 is a lot, so."},{"text":"Calling the approved $60,000 budget “plenty for us” centers our price range rather than clarifying what outcomes they expect for it.","segment":"s08-s007","quote":"that's plenty for us"},{"text":"Avoid a blanket integration assurance; confirm the specific warehouse system and what integration will require before saying yes.","segment":"s08-s009","quote":"we integrate with pretty much everything."}]}
